items.name: parse
items.summary: A convenience routine for parsing a pattern into an HIR value with the default configuration.

items.name: parse_many
items.summary: A convenience routine for parsing many patterns into HIR value with the default configuration.

items.name: parse_many_with
items.summary: A convenience routine for parsing many patterns into HIR values using a `Config`.

items.name: parse_with
items.summary: A convenience routine for parsing a pattern into an HIR value using a `Config`.

items.name: Config
items.summary: A common set of configuration options that apply to the syntax of a regex.

methods.name: case_insensitive
methods.summary: Enable or disable the case insensitive flag by default.

methods.name: crlf
methods.summary: Enable or disable the "CRLF mode" flag by default.

methods.name: dot_matches_new_line
methods.summary: Enable or disable the "dot matches any character" flag by default.

methods.name: get_case_insensitive
methods.summary: Returns whether "case insensitive" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_crlf
methods.summary: Returns whether "CRLF" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_dot_matches_new_line
methods.summary: Returns whether "dot matches new line" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_ignore_whitespace
methods.summary: Returns whether "ignore whitespace" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_line_terminator
methods.summary: Returns the line terminator in this syntax configuration.

methods.name: get_multi_line
methods.summary: Returns whether "multi line" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_nest_limit
methods.summary: Returns the "nest limit" setting.

methods.name: get_octal
methods.summary: Returns whether "octal" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_swap_greed
methods.summary: Returns whether "swap greed" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_unicode
methods.summary: Returns whether "unicode" mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_utf8
methods.summary: Returns whether UTF-8 mode is enabled.

methods.name: ignore_whitespace
methods.summary: Enable verbose mode in the regular expression.

methods.name: line_terminator
methods.summary: Sets the line terminator for use with `(?u-s:.)` and `(?-us:.)`.

methods.name: multi_line
methods.summary: Enable or disable the multi-line matching flag by default.

methods.name: nest_limit
methods.summary: Set the nesting limit used for the regular expression parser.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Return a new default syntax configuration.

methods.name: octal
methods.summary: Whether to support octal syntax or not.

methods.name: swap_greed
methods.summary: Enable or disable the "swap greed" flag by default.

methods.name: unicode
methods.summary: Enable or disable the Unicode flag (`u`) by default.

methods.name: utf8
methods.summary: When disabled, the builder will permit the construction of a regular expression that may match invalid UTF-8.
